about.title: Indonesia's trusted partner in fiber and connectivity.
about.lead: PT International Information Technology is a company established in 2023, engaged in Fiber Optic, FTTH and Telecommunication Solutions.
about.body1: We are here to meet the growing demand for network infrastructure in the digital era — serving residential areas, office buildings, industrial sectors, and internet service providers.
about.body2: As a network solution provider, we are committed to delivering reliable, high-quality services. By prioritising premium materials and the support of an experienced technical team, we handle every project with professional standards and on-time execution. We also offer a wide range of fiber optic products and accessories that comply with industry standards.
about.body3: Our main strength lies in the quality of our work and our responsive customer service. We believe client satisfaction is the foundation of our growth — which is why we always prioritise clear communication, effective solutions, proactive technical support and reliable after-sales service.
